uses.quote: Simple copy and paste of Gen AI outputs for assessment submission
Apprentices must not submit the output of Gen AI in any work submitted to their portfolio for End Point Assessment
If there is no explicit mention being allowed to use AI in your summative assessment brief, then you must not use AI in any part of the final submission.
Write a speech that forms the basis of a viva, advocacy exam or other assessed presentation where this is not explicitly allowed in the presentation instructions
you should not use any software to rewrite sentences or make substantive changes to your original work unless conditions in the assignment brief explicitly allows it.
You can use spelling, grammar-checking software and thesauri to assist you in your writing. Some of these may be AI powered
Where explicitly allowed in the assignment brief, you are able use Gen AI tools to suggest frameworks on which you can structure your assignment.
Non-approved Gen AI tools can conduct research and find papers that may be relevant to your studies.
you could upload 3 papers or documents that are in the public domain that relate you your subject/problem/assignment and ask ChatGPT to provide a summary of the contrasting points and evidence.
You are allowed to use Gen AI tools to upload your own writing and thoughts to begin a discussion or self-reflection with the AI to gain insight into your writing.
It is acceptable to ask Gen AI tools to provide feedback and suggest improvements to your own written work.
Gen AI tools are great at helping kick start a thought process or to generate ideas for a topic for discussion.
Supporting you to develop your coding skills through advice of coding structure and syntax where this is not an assessed skill or intended learning outcome.
Translating content to or from English, excluding any personal, client or business confidential content
